description:
Music to Quiet the Mind | Slow Sarod | 1.5 Hours

The mind won't stop. The thoughts keep spiraling on top of each other.

You know that feeling — every time you try to sit still, another loop starts. What you didn't say. What you should have done. What's coming tomorrow. The harder you try to quiet it down, the louder it gets. You don't need to *fix* anything. You just need a sound steady enough to give the noise somewhere to land.

That's what the Sarod does here. Its notes are deep and rounded, sliding into each other without edges — slow enough that the mind has nothing to grab onto and chase. This is 90 minutes of slow Sarod in Raga Bhupali — a serene, pentatonic evening raga, light and peaceful, with no sharp turns. Just space for the inner noise to ease.

Play it when the thoughts won't quiet, when you sit down to read but can't, when the evening needs to slow before anything else can happen.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Sarod — deep, glassy, resonant plucked strings with long sliding sustain
- Raga Bhupali — a serene pentatonic evening raga, peaceful and unhurried
- Soft tanpura drone underneath, holding the calm
- Light, sparse tabla kept very low — presence without momentum
- 90 unbroken minutes at 432Hz tuning

⏱ Chapters
0:00    The first notes — settling in
20:00   The thinking starts to slow
45:00   Quiet and serene
70:00   The mind softens
85:00   Gentle close

🧠 How to use:
Press play and stop reaching for things. Let the Sarod's slow slides set the pace and let the inner noise ease around it. No effort required — just listen.

⏱ Best for:
• An overthinking, racing mind
• Spiraling thoughts at the end of the day
• Quiet evenings when you can't sit still
• Slow reading or sitting with the first quiet hour
• Settling the inner noise without forcing it

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Raga Bhupali — serene pentatonic (audava) evening raga. Sa Re Ga Pa Dha Sa — only five notes, NO Ma and NO Ni. The absence of the 4th and 7th gives it an open, light, peaceful character with no tension or sharp resolution — ideal for end-of-week calm. TABLA: light tabla is fine for Sarod, but keep it VERY low and sparse here — this is evening calm, not energetic; tabla should add quiet presence, not momentum. If in doubt, drop it entirely. Soft tanpura drone holds the floor. Theta 5Hz binaural — deep relaxation without pushing toward sleep (this is settling, not sleep music). LUFS -15 (evening calm, slightly quieter than morning-active). EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION (3 metaphors, one per clip): clip 1: 'like the mind finally finding somewhere to land' · clip 2: 'the shoulders finally dropping after a long stretch of days' · clip 3: 'Sunday becoming Monday without any rush'. 90min = 3-4 Suno clips + loop extension. NOTE: this is a DIFFERENT raga and DIFFERENT lane from the June 2 Sarod (Ahir Bhairav, morning-cognitive/clear-head) — this is Bhupali, evening-calm/Sunday wind-down.
